files.description: Streaming subscribers, one per row (320 rows): subscriber_id (whole number), age (years, from 19 to 87; about 1% empty), tier (basic, plus or premium; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), monthly_fee (two decimals; about 3% empty), joined_year (whole number).

task_text: Count the subscribers per tier, using tier names in lower case without surrounding spaces. `result` should be a table with the columns tier and subscribers.
intended_computation: Clean tier (3 tiers) and count the 320 subscribers per tier; return tier and subscribers.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the derived tier key is dropped from the column-style group output, so tier is missing; 3.x keeps it
